## 中文

Agent Orbit v0.0.1：Agent 额度、Token 用量与 CLI 审批悬浮工具。

- 侧边 AI 图标圆环、悬停详情、拖动贴边、独立主窗口和后台运行。
- Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 本地 Token 时间轴。
- 新增用户级 Codex 审批入口，按原会话隔离确认，覆盖同一 CODEX_HOME 下支持 Hook 的窗口和项目。

下载 Agent-Orbit-0.0.1-macOS-x64.zip，解压后将 Agent Orbit.app 放入 Applications。适用于 macOS 11+、Intel x86_64。本构建未签名、未公证。SHA256SUMS.txt 提供完整性校验。

已知限制：原 Codex 客户端的真实多窗口审批联调仍待验收；各客户端必须支持、加载并信任 PermissionRequest Hook。本次仅提供 macOS Intel 二进制，未附带 Apple Silicon、Windows 或 Linux 安装包。

## English

Agent Orbit v0.0.1 monitors agent quotas and token usage with an edge HUD and CLI approvals.

- AI quota rings, hover details, drag-to-edge docking, an independent workspace and background operation.
- Local Codex, Claude Code and Gemini CLI token timelines.
- A user-level Codex approval dispatcher with isolated original-session decisions across supported windows/projects sharing one CODEX_HOME.

Download and extract Agent-Orbit-0.0.1-macOS-x64.zip, then move Agent Orbit.app into Applications. Requires macOS 11+, Intel x86_64. This build is unsigned and not notarized. Verify the archive with SHA256SUMS.txt.

Known limitations: real existing-client multi-window approval integration is not yet accepted. Clients must support, load and trust PermissionRequest hooks. Only a macOS Intel binary is included; Apple Silicon, Windows and Linux installers are not included.
